question: Name the classical dancer who is associated with the Kuchipudi classical dance.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Vempati Chinna Satyam.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vempati Chinna Satyam (15 October 1929 – 29 July 2012) was an Indian dancer and a guru of the Kuchipudi dance form.
 
• Born in 1929 in a traditional family of Kuchipudi dancers Sri Chinna Satyam received training in Kuchipudi from T. Perayya Sastry, Vedantam Lakshminarayana Sastry and Vampati Sat yam. 
 
• Later he established the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Madras in 1963 and trained many noted Kuchipudi dancers who are now giving solo recitals allover the country and abroad. 
 
• He is an imaginative and creative choreographer and has produced many dance dramas in the Kuchipudi style.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
